nguon: W3Schools https://www.w3schools.com/excel/ (batch3: Tra cuu + Mang dong + Ngay thang + Kien thuc nen + HowTo)

HowTo.giai_thich: W3Schools: doi gio sang giay bang cach nhan voi 86400; Excel luu gio dang phan so cua ngay (15:00 = 15/24 = 0.625). FINAL chua co meo 86400.
W3Schools HowTo: tinh NPV (gia tri hien tai rong) theo tung buoc; rate la ty le chiet khau, value la cac dong tien.
HowTo.vi_du: =NPV(B9,B2:K2) voi rate 10% o B9, cashflow 10 nam B2:K2 -> 377,87

HowTo.giai_thich: W3Schools HowTo: lenh xoa dong trung lap theo 1+ cot (Data tab, ribbon); xoa han du lieu goc nen dung can than; khac ham UNIQUE (chi tao danh sach moi). FINAL chua co lenh nay.
HowTo.vi_du: Chon Column B (Age) > Remove Duplicates > OK: 1 gia tri trung bi xoa, con 3 gia tri duy nhat

Kien thuc nen.cu_phap: =A1+A2 (moi cong thuc bat dau bang dau =)
Kien thuc nen.giai_thich: W3Schools: khai niem cong thuc (tinh truc tiep =1+1 hoac qua o =A1+A2); ket hop fill E2:E4 va ham SUM; doi gia tri o thi ket qua tu cap nhat.
Kien thuc nen.vi_du: =B2+C2+D2 dem Pokeball cua Iva = 6; =SUM(E2:E4) tong 3 nguoi = 33

Kien thuc nen.giai_thich: W3Schools: trang tong hop ~50 ham (AND..XOR) ke ten va mo ta 1 dong, kem link chi tiet tung ham; khong co vi du chay cu the ngoai mau =SUM(A1:A5).
Kien thuc nen.vi_du: =SUM(A1:A5); danh muc: AND, AVERAGE, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, TODAY...

Kien thuc nen.giai_thich: W3Schools: cu phap co ban (chon o, go =, tham chieu o, toan tu + - * /); gia tri o duoc truyen qua tham chieu (A1(309)).

Mang dong.giai_thich: W3Schools: tra ve cac dong thoa DK, tran (spill), du lieu goc khong doi; nhieu DK AND dung *, OR dung +; khong khop -> #CALC!; chi co 365/2021+.

W3Schools: ban sao sap xep tran, du lieu goc khong doi; sort_index la so cot dem tu trai, sort_order 1 tang / -1 giam; long duoc voi FILTER; chi co 365/2021+. FINAL chi co lenh Sort thu cong, chua co ham SORT.
Mang dong.vi_du: =SORT(A2:E21,5,-1) sap theo Total giam; =SORT(B2:B21) ten A-Z; =SORT(FILTER(A2:E21,C2:C21="Normal"),5,-1)

Mang dong.giai_thich: W3Schools: liet ke gia tri rieng biet tran theo thu tu xuat hien; dem bang COUNTA(H2#); o trong hien 0 (loc truoc bang FILTER); exactly_once TRUE chi lay gia tri xuat hien dung 1 lan; chi co 365/2021+. FINAL chi loc unique bang COUNTIF+MATCH+INDEX, chua co ham UNIQUE.
Mang dong.vi_du: =UNIQUE(C2:C21) -> Grass, Fire, Water, Bug, Normal; =COUNTA(UNIQUE(C2:C21)) -> 5; =SORT(UNIQUE(C2:C21)) sap A-Z

Ngay thang.giai_thich: W3Schools: khoang cach 2 ngay theo unit "Y","M","D","MD","YM","YD"; go het ten ham (khong hien goi y); start phai <= end (sai ra #NUM!); khuyen khong dung "MD".
W3Schools: dem ngay lam viec T2-T6 giua 2 ngay, tinh ca ngay dau/cuoi; holidays la vung ngay le (dang $H$2:$H$5 khi fill); le roi vao cuoi tuan khong tru 2 lan.
W3Schools: ngay hien tai, tu cap nhat moi lan mo/tinh lai workbook; ngay luu dang so serial (2026-09-28 = 46293) nen tru truc tiep ra so ngay; Ctrl+; chen ngay cung.
Ngay thang.vi_du: =TODAY()-C2 so ngay ke tu ngay dat hang; tinh tuoi: =DATEDIF(B2,TODAY(),"Y"); NOW() kem ca gio

Tra cuu.giai_thich: W3Schools: tim kiem doc theo cot; cot lookup phai nam ben trai; range_lookup FALSE(0) khop chinh xac, TRUE(1) gan dung (cot 1 sap xep tang dan); khong thay -> #N/A.
Tra cuu.vi_du: =VLOOKUP(H3,A2:E21,2,1) tim ten Pokemon theo ID# (H3=7 -> Squirtle); ban an toan: =VLOOKUP(H3,A2:E21,2,0)

Tra cuu.giai_thich: W3Schools: ban ngang cua VLOOKUP; tim tren hang tren cung cua vung va tra gia tri tu hang row_index_num (dem tu tren); FALSE khop chinh xac.
Tra cuu.vi_du: =HLOOKUP(B5,B1:H3,2,FALSE) tim gia theo ten mon (Ultra Ball -> 1200); doi row_index_num=3 lay Category

Tra cuu.giai_thich: W3Schools: ban moi linh hoat cua VLOOKUP; nhin duoc sang trai, mac dinh khop chinh xac, khong can so cot; return nhieu cot tran sang phai; chi co 365/2021/2024/web.
Tra cuu.vi_du: =XLOOKUP(H3,B2:B21,E2:E21) lay Total theo ten; =XLOOKUP(H3,B2:B21,A2:A21) nhin sang trai lay ID#; =XLOOKUP(H3,B2:B21,E2:E21,"Not found")

Tra cuu.giai_thich: W3Schools: tra gia tri tai vi tri trong vung; vi tri dem tu o dau vung (them/bot hang tieu de lech 1); vuot vung -> #REF!.
W3Schools: tra VI TRI chu khong tra gia tri; khong phan biet hoa/thuong; match_type 0 khop chinh xac (luon dung 0), 1/-1 can sap xep; khong thay -> #N/A.
Tra cuu.vi_du: =MATCH(H3,B2:B21,0) -> 7 (Squirtle o B8, vung bat dau B2); =MATCH(H3,A1:E1,0) vi tri cot theo header

Tra cuu.giai_thich: W3Schools: ghep MATCH tim vi tri + INDEX lay gia tri; nhu VLOOKUP nhung nhin moi huong, dung range (chen cot khong vo), chay moi Excel; 2 MATCH lam tra cuu 2 chieu.
